title: Competition Committee discusses "aiding the runner," but no proposals to ban the tush push

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Competition Committee discusses "aiding the runner," but no proposals to ban the tush push
sources.description: The NFL won't be discussing a proposal to ban the tush push this offseason, but there could be further conversations about other ways that offensive players aid ball carriers.
